relations.title: Annex 7 — Reference Architecture and Implementation
relations.reading: The contracting vehicle, decision owner and execution platform remain distinct even when they participate in the same operational handoff.

relations.title: Field Intelligence in Chicontepec and the Texas–Mérida Corridor
relations.reading: Field capability and programme performance belong to different levels; the Chicontepec integration case adds the contractual, territorial and governance conditions between them.

relations.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
relations.reading: The territorial dimension makes the frame explicit: an operating outcome must be evaluated against the affected recipients and obligations, not only the contractor's local target.
